definitions.explanation: The official language of a country.
The subject of Japanese language arts in school.

notes:
{国語|こくご} means "national language." In Japan, this specifically refers to the Japanese language, especially as a school subject.

COMPOUNDS:
- {国語|こくご}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: Japanese-language dictionary
- {国語|こくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: Japanese textbook
- {国語|こくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: Japanese language class
- {国語|こくご}⟦{力|りょく}→力：noentry⟧: Japanese language ability

AS A SCHOOL SUBJECT:
{国語|こくご} is one of the core subjects in Japanese education, covering reading, writing, grammar, and literature. It is equivalent to "Language Arts" or "English" class in English-speaking countries.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国語|こくご}: Japanese as a native language/school subject
- ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧: Japanese language (used when talking about it as a foreign language or linguistically)
